crossRefs.note: Jesus told it, “May no one ever eat fruit from you again!” and his disciples heard it.

translations.web: As they passed by in the morning, they saw the fig tree withered away from the roots.
translations.bsb: As they were walking back in the morning, they saw the fig tree withered from its roots.
translations.kjv: And in the morning, as they passed by, they saw the fig tree dried up from the roots.
translations.asv: And as they passed by in the morning, they saw the fig tree withered away from the roots.
